source.name: jira
source.fetch: curl -sS -u "$JIRA_USER:$JIRA_API_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST "$JIRA_SITE/rest/api/3/search/jql" -d '{"jql":"labels = navi-delivery AND statusCategory != Done","fields":["summary","description"],"maxResults":20}' | jq --arg site "$JIRA_SITE" '[.issues[] | {id: .key, title: .fields.summary, url: ($site + "/browse/" + .key)}]'

pr.command: gh pr create --base "$NAVI_BASE" --head "$NAVI_BRANCH" --title "$NAVI_ITEM_TITLE" --body "Proposed by navi-cron from $NAVI_ITEM_ID ($NAVI_ITEM_URL). Nothing in this branch has been reviewed by a person."
